method: Searched Xiaohongshu for 幼儿园手工作业 家长崩溃 and 幼儿园手工作业 逼疯家长, read the search suggestions as a demand list, opened the highest-comment note (5,207 likes / 2,369 comments) and read down the thread including the dissenting voices; then compared against the tutorial supply by searching 手工作业 不会做 求教程. Cross-checked the board's 581-entry radar index: 手工作业 / 幼儿园 / 幼师 appear zero times.
gap: Xiaohongshu is saturated with craft tutorials — individual ones at 153k, 97k, 77k likes — and none of them help, because they are all 'look what I made' with materials the poster happened to have and dexterity a child does not have. Nothing runs the problem backwards from constraints: your recycling, your remaining forty minutes, your child's age, the teacher's theme. So the parent scrolls, gives up choosing, and does it herself.

zh.pain: 晚上九点，幼儿园的手工作业明天要交，拿着剪刀的那位家长自己就不会做手工——于是她自己动手做得也不好看，孩子第二天交上去一件他自己都嫌丑的东西。
zh.kill: 这些帖子里最响的共识是「这件事本来就不该存在」——央广网评「手工作业还是形式主义？」被转成 198 赞的帖子。做一个帮家长把作业做得更漂亮的东西，是站在被骂的那一侧。同帖里一位小学美术老师的判断：家长自己卷自己，才把这件事搞坏的。而母婴生态里任何一家小程序都能在一周内加上这个功能。
zh.move: 刻意站在反内卷那一侧：永不输出「大人做的那一版」，不做作品评比与打分，每一步都标清楚大人可以碰哪里。这不是修饰，这是它与平台上已经在接单的代做服务之间唯一的分界，也正好是那条 529 赞评论在伸手要的东西。冷启动·中文＝「幼儿园手工作业家长崩溃」「逼疯家长」两个词落地的评论区，以及「有没有需要幼儿园手工作业的家长」这条联想词背后已经在接单的那批人。冷启动·英文＝r/Parenting 与 r/Teachers 每年万圣节服装与 science fair 前一周准时出现的「我孩子的作业明天就要交」帖。
zh.hook: 晚上九点，幼儿园手工作业明天要交，拿着剪刀的那位家长自己就不会做手工——于是她替孩子做了，做得很丑，孩子第二天交上去一件自己都嫌丑的东西。
zh.does: 拍下家里真正有的东西——那个纸箱、那卷胶带、剩下的四十分钟——加上孩子的年龄和老师给的主题；输出一份孩子自己能做完的步骤，逐步标明哪一步大人可以碰。
zh.counter: 这些帖子里声音最大的共识是这作业根本就不该存在，官媒都发过「手工作业是不是形式主义」并被转发。任何帮家长把作业做得更好看的工具，都是在给家长自己在抱怨的那场军备竞赛添柴。更难的一条：代做这门生意已经有人在小红书接单收钱，你要跟「直接替孩子做完」的人竞争。
zh.differentiator: 它故意站在反外包那一侧：永不输出大人做的那一版、不给结果打分或排名、每一步都标明大人可碰的边界——这也正是它与本板 R5「代际代劳」排除区的分界：产物是反代劳，不替孩子做，让孩子自己做得完。冷启动中文：小红书「幼儿园手工作业」帖下，按对方晒出的材料回一份孩子能自己做完的步骤；英文：r/Parenting 的 craft-homework 吐槽帖。
zh.consumer_angle: 买主是一位手笨的家长。交付物是睡前完成、且是孩子自己做的那一件。

workload_note: 2w for one theme and one artefact end to end.
pain: It is nine at night, the kindergarten craft assignment is due tomorrow, and the parent holding the scissors cannot make things — so she makes it herself, badly, and her child hands in something he is embarrassed by.
kill: The loudest consensus in these threads is that the assignment should not exist at all — state media ran a piece asking whether craft homework is just performative, and it was reposted for 198 likes. Building anything that helps parents produce nicer homework stands on the side people are angry at. A primary-school art teacher in the same thread: parents competing with each other is what ruined it. And any maternal-and-baby WeChat mini-program could add this in a week.
move: Take the anti-arms-race side deliberately: never output the adult-made version, never rank or score results, and always mark which step the grown-up may touch. That is not a garnish — it is what separates this from the outsourcing services already selling on the platform, and it is the exact thing the highest-signal voice in the thread was reaching for. Cold start, Chinese: the comment sections under 幼儿园手工作业家长崩溃 and 逼疯家长, plus the people already taking paid orders behind the suggestion 有没有需要幼儿园手工作业的家长. Cold start, English: r/Parenting and r/Teachers every year in the week before Halloween costumes and the science fair, where 'my kid's project is due tomorrow' arrives on schedule.
wallet: 强：淘宝上代做手工作业的服务已经在接单收钱
hook: It is nine at night, the kindergarten craft assignment is due tomorrow, and the parent holding the scissors cannot make things — so she makes it herself, badly, and her child hands in something he is embarrassed by.
does: Photograph what is actually in the house — the cardboard box, the tape, the forty minutes left — plus the child's age and the teacher's theme. Out comes a plan the child can execute, step by step, marked with which parts the grown-up may touch.
counter: The loudest consensus in these threads is that the assignment should not exist at all; state media ran a piece asking whether craft homework is performative and it was reposted widely. Anything that helps parents produce nicer homework is fuel for the arms race the parents are complaining about. And there is already a paid outsourcing market — you would be competing with people who simply do it for the child.
differentiator: Deliberately anti-outsourcing: it never outputs the adult-made version, never scores or ranks results, and marks every step the grown-up may touch — which is also the line separating it from the board's 代际代劳 exclusion, since the artefact is anti-proxy by construction. Cold start 中文: reply under 小红书 craft-homework threads with a plan built from the materials they photographed. EN: the craft-homework vent threads in r/Parenting.
consumer_angle: The buyer is a parent who is bad at crafts. The deliverable is a finished piece, made by the child, before bedtime.
